0.original: Qhoterl Pasol is attempting, unsuccessfully, to close her nostrils.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

1.original: Deliver the requested items to Qhoterl Pasol.

48.original: Sometimes I wish I didn't have such a sensitive nose. When the workers come back from the caves, they carry with them the most pungent of odors! It really is quite unbearable!

49.original: Unfortunately, even a thorough scrubbing with warm water does little to remove the stench. I fear there is little choice but to resort to a rarely used treatment, and as you can imagine, the ingredients required are also rather rare themselves...

50.original: First, I'll need roughly three pinches of natron. Your cooperation will be most appreciated, I assure you!

51.original: First, I'll need roughly three marimo. Your cooperation will be most appreciated, I assure you!

52.original: First, I'll need a sponge, the living sort, but you'll need to hook the little scoundrel with your spear as they're far too crafty to take any bait. Your cooperation will be most appreciated, I assure you!

53.original: In order to proceed with this quest, you must first complete the quest “A New Fishing Ex-spear-ience” and unlock spearfishing.

54.original: Oh! I forgot to mention that you'll need to dive into the waters of Lake Tusi Mek'ta to find it!

55.original: Oh! I forgot to mention that you'll need to dive into the waters of Lake Tusi Mek'ta to find them!

56.original: It seems that Lake Tusi Mek'ta is relatively free of large, flesh-eating beasts, so your chances of being devoured alive are actually quite low! Welcome news, I'm sure!

57.original: Have you brought what I asked for? Please say you have!

58.original: Marvelous! Once the concoction is ready, those reeking reprobates will be the very pinnacle of cleanliness in just a few scrubs!

59.original: At the top of my list of candidates are my husband and son. Their combined stench is enough to curdle milk!
